maddeler.e:
استعرضا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْرَضَا (istaʕraḍā) /is.taʕ.ra.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# اُسْتُعْرِضَا (ustuʕriḍā) /us.tuʕ.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# اِسْتَعْرِضَا (istaʕriḍā) /is.taʕ.ri.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
